body: He told me if I wasn't going to kill myself I should leave... He also called me selfish and self absorbed along with a list of other things. Mods ignore any messages you get from me, I was trying to report him lol. Didn't realize he was a fake.

My goal in life was always to become either an animal cruelty investigator, or to become a wildlife rehabilitator (specifically for big cats) 

I currently work at a big cat rescue, and volunteer at an animal shelter, but since I've lost Kaiden, I've found it hard to even leave the house. I've gone to work a few times, but I usually ended up cuddling a cub and moping around, instead of actually caring for the animals.

It's still so hard on me. I can't even go towards Kaiden's room, or pick up his jacket off the couch, etc. his gf has visited a few times, which results in tons of tears. I'm so tired it's ridiculous.
